operations.command: mkdir -p '.vm/e2e/{{state}}-{{stateHashShort}}' && nix-build tests/boot-touch --arg rotate {{rotate}} --no-out-link --keep-failed --cores 4 --max-jobs 2 > '.vm/e2e/{{state}}-{{stateHashShort}}/test.log' 2>&1 || { tail -80 '.vm/e2e/{{state}}-{{stateHashShort}}/test.log'; exit 1; }
